statement: For a source-valid exact conditional representation Q=(X_S+m(X_D))^T B(X_S+m(X_D))+lambda(z^T X_D+h)^2+r with S a two-original-coordinate bank, D a disjoint original-coordinate bank, B invertible indefinite, determinant magnitude detB, kappa=sigma_min(B), rho=|lambda| ||z||_2^2, set R=8 sqrt(detB/(kappa rho)). Then Q has a continuous C0 density and ||p_Q||_infinity <=2 detB^(-1/2) Psi(R), Psi(R)=2sqrt(R) for R<=1 and 2+log R for R>=1. If kappa>=1 and rho>=1, the bound is <8.159.
